title: Protective roles of carbon quantum dots in improving root physiology of dragonhead under cadmium toxicity
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00876J, Paper
S. Rahimzadeh, K. Ghassemi-Golezani
Carbon quantum dots (CQDs) improved root growth and stress tolerance in Cd-exposed dragonhead by reducing Cd uptake and restoring physiological responses.
